core: NOD-like receptor sensing of bacterial peptidoglycan
qualifier: with K63 ubiquitination and inflammasome signaling
name: NOD-like receptor peptidoglycan sensing via K63 ubiquitination and inflammasomes
rationale: All members concern innate detection of bacterial peptidoglycan/muramyl dipeptide by NOD1/2-type receptors; unlike the confusables (NOD regulation terms, TAK1/TLR cascades) the theme carries the inflammasome and K63-linked ubiquitination steps.

name: Motile cilium axoneme assembly and multiciliogenesis
rationale: Members build motile cilia (dynein arms, central apparatus, basal bodies, sperm axoneme, multiciliated cell centrioles) and their clearance function, without the left/right asymmetry, sperm motility, CSF flow or tubulin-modification terms of the confusables.

qualifier: HDL and LDL with phospholipid efflux
name: HDL and LDL remodeling with phospholipid efflux
rationale: Members cover HDL/LDL particle remodeling and assembly with ABC-transporter phospholipid efflux and homeostasis, whereas confusables centre on cholesterol efflux regulation, ABCA1 disease/apoA-I signaling or intestinal lipid absorption.

name: NGF signaling with p75NTR and dependence-receptor cell death
rationale: All members belong to NGF/neurotrophin receptor signaling, and the theme is distinguished from TRK-activation confusables by its p75NTR death/survival branches (NRIF, NRAGE, NADE, ceramide, regulated proteolysis) and dependence-receptor caspase activation.

name: Differentiated intestinal epithelium identity and barrier maintenance
rationale: Nearly all members describe CDX/HNF4-driven differentiated gut epithelium and its development and structural maintenance (leukocyte migration is an outlier), distinct from crypt stem cell, antimicrobial, pancreatic and intestine-liver/kidney brush-border confusables.

name: Glomerular mesangium and endothelium development and filtration
rationale: Members concern glomerular mesangial and endothelial development, glomerular vasculature and filtration/albumin handling, whereas confusables concern metanephric mesenchyme, nephric duct and ureteric bud.

name: Glycosylase-initiated base excision repair involving NEIL1 and NEIL3
rationale: Members cover DNA glycosylase lesion recognition, base cleavage and AP-site resolution, with NEIL1/NEIL3 defects and NEIL3 crosslink repair distinguishing it from gap-filling, OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1 defect and direct-reversal confusables.

name: Antigen-experienced memory B cell gene signatures
rationale: Members are B cell expression modules, memory B cell signature and adaptive immune memory, lacking the naive B cell signatures of C1 and the germinal-centre/Tfh/plasma cell terms of the other confusables.

qualifier: MHC class I and II, including cross-presentation
name: MHC class I and II peptide antigen presentation, including cross-presentation
rationale: Members span antigen processing, peptide loading and MHC I/II presentation including cross-presentation and viral MHC/CD4 downregulation, without the CD1/NKT lipid presentation or PD-L1/proteasome terms of the confusables.

name: O-fucosylation of thrombospondin type 1 repeat proteins
rationale: All three members describe O-fucose glycosylation of TSR-domain proteins and its B3GALTL defect (Peters-plus), distinct from the keratan sulfate and glycosaminoglycan confusables.

name: Phosphatidylinositol synthesis and inter-membrane phospholipid transfer
rationale: Members concern PI synthesis and non-vesicular transfer of PI/PC between membranes, unlike the confusables on other glycerophospholipid synthesis/remodeling, RAB/WNT trafficking or flippases.

name: p53 regulation driving p21-mediated G1 arrest
rationale: Members cover TP53 expression and co-factor regulation and its transcriptional induction of p21 and G1 arrest genes, distinct from p53 apoptotic targets, G2 arrest and RB1/E2F confusables.

qualifier: catecholamine and serotonin metabolism, drug-reward behavior
name: Catecholamine and serotonin neurotransmission, metabolism and drug-reward behavior
rationale: Members cover dopamine, norepinephrine and serotonin synthesis, uptake, degradation, dopamine receptor signaling and drug/reward behaviors, versus cholinergic/purinergic, neuropeptide, amino-acid transmitter and alcohol confusables.

qualifier: G6PC/SLC37A4 hydrolysis and transport, glucokinase regulation
name: Glucose-6-phosphate hydrolysis, transport and glucokinase regulation
rationale: Members concern glucose-6-phosphatase and its transporter (GSD Ia/Ib, G6PC3), hexose phosphate transport and glucokinase/GCKR control, lacking the glycogen synthesis/breakdown and glucagon terms of the confusables.

name: Atrial and ventricular compact myocardium morphogenesis
rationale: All three members are morphogenesis of atrial, left ventricular and compact myocardium, distinct from trabecular, endocardial and second heart field confusables.

name: Male germline spermatogenesis and sperm chromatin condensation
rationale: Members cover spermatogonial maintenance and division, Y-linked and spermatogenesis genes, and sperm DNA/protamine chromatin remodeling, without the piRNA, oocyte and zygotic programming terms of the confusables.

qualifier: Golgi, with sulfation and nucleotide-sugar transport
name: Golgi glycoconjugate biosynthesis, sulfation and nucleotide-sugar transport
rationale: Members are biosynthesis of O-glycans, proteoglycans, complex N-glycans, glycolipids and blood-group antigens plus PAPS/nucleotide-sugar supply and their defects, unlike the lysosomal degradation and ER dolichol/GPI confusables.

name: Eye development, phototransduction and retinoid metabolism
rationale: Members cover retina, lens and eye morphogenesis, opsin phototransduction and the retinoid/vitamin A cycle, distinct from ciliary trafficking, placental and inner-ear confusables.

name: Canonical NF-kappaB activation via IKK recruitment downstream of TLRs
rationale: Members concern IKK complex recruitment by IRAK1, RIP1 and TICAM1 and positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB, lacking the TNFR1, non-canonical NF-kappaB and TAK1-activation terms of the confusables.

name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte adhesion and transendothelial migration
rationale: Members cover integrin activation, leukocyte adhesion, PECAM1 and diapedesis/extravasation, without the immunological synapse, negative adhesion regulation or Rap1 signaling terms of the confusables.

name: Cone opsin light absorption and color vision defects
rationale: All members concern opsin light absorption and OPN1SW/MW/LW loss of function, distinct from the retinoid cycle and phototransduction cascade confusables.

core: Endothelial specification and arterial vessel morphogenesis
name: BMP-promoted endothelial specification and arterial vessel morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover endothelial fate (arterial, venous, lymphatic) and great-artery/outflow morphogenesis with positive BMP/SMAD signaling, versus confusables with BMP inhibition, Nodal asymmetry or adherens junction terms.

name: Post-lanosterol cholesterol synthesis and oxysterol bile acid synthesis
rationale: Members cover Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell cholesterol synthesis and 24/27-hydroxycholesterol bile acid synthesis (CYP27A1), lacking the mevalonate/lanosterol and other CYP disease terms of the confusables.

name: Scavenger receptor clearance of apoptotic cells and hyaluronan
rationale: Members cover scavenger receptor classes, apoptotic cell recognition and engulfment, immune complex clearance and hyaluronan degradation, without the oxLDL/foam cell, microglia and amyloid-beta terms of the confusables.

name: Podocyte nephrin interactions and cytoskeletal organization
rationale: Members concern nephrin-family podocyte interactions and migration plus cortical microtubule organization, unlike the epithelial polarity, lamellipodium and filopodium/RHO confusables.
